public.title: Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)
public.description: Process ["insert",value], ["remove",value], and ["getRandom",ticket] on an initially empty set. Insert/remove return whether membership changed. For deterministic testing getRandom returns denseArray[ticket], where ticket is a valid current zero-based index: insert appends, removal swaps the last element into the removed slot then pops. Reads occur only when nonempty. At most 500 operations; integer values are between -10000 and 10000. This explicit-ticket adaptation tests value/state behavior, not statistical randomness. Aim for O(1) per operation.
hints: Store a dense array and a map from value to index.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Swapping the last element into a removed slot keeps the array dense while the map enables constant-time updates. Explicit tickets make reads reproducible. O(1) expected time per operation.
